item_arguments_and_dependencies.claim_and_conventions: Defines the truth, forward-map, additive-noise, sampling-law, working-family, and prior-support objects separately; allows nonlinear maps and restricted admissible truth/operator pairs; asserts no posterior existence or convergence.

For two equal observation laws and metric-separated targets Delta apart, every common randomized rule has max risk at least Delta/2; proves the bound directly for arbitrary measurable sample spaces and extended nonnegative risk.

item_arguments_and_dependencies.claim_and_conventions: An explicit restricted two-operator configuration class has target distance bounded by data distance, so omega(t)=t is a uniform modulus.
Identity and half-scale operators map truths 1 and 2 to the same signal, so every common additive noise law gives equal data laws while target distance is 1.
